errors.cannotReach: web_search: cannot reach the Baidu AI Search endpoint {endpoint} — try: check your network or proxy, then retry, or switch engines in Settings (General page).
errors.missingKey: web_search: Baidu AI Search requires an API key — set BAIDU_API_KEY or QIANFAN_API_KEY env var, or configure `baiduApiKey` in ~/.reasonix/config.json. Get one from Baidu Cloud Qianfan.
errors.unauthorized: web_search: Baidu AI Search API key rejected — check BAIDU_API_KEY, QIANFAN_API_KEY, or `baiduApiKey`.
errors.rateLimit: web_search: Baidu AI Search rate-limited or quota exceeded — wait and retry, or switch engines in Settings (General page).
errors.serverError: web_search: Baidu AI Search server error ({status}) — try again later, or switch engines in Settings (General page).
errors.parseError: web_search: Baidu AI Search returned unparseable response (HTTP {status}) — try again later
